title: SB98 (136th Legislature (2025-2026)): Prohibit firearm possession - certain domestic violence offenses

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Ohio) (gun-policy Stage 5, Ohio); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Ohio text (As Introduced (00_IN), ; official copy, https://search-prod.lis.state.oh.us/api/v2/general_assembly_136/legislation/sb98/00_IN/pdf/ (Open States text id 90139027))
provenance.note: Introduced version (00_IN); no later versions or votes in the record. In R.C. 2923.14(F)(4) the bill strikes 'or,' after (A)(2) and adds 'or (6)'; the quote shows the text after the bill. Existing law in 2923.13(A) (unquoted) makes it a third-degree felony to acquire, have, carry or use a firearm while under a listed disability.
